title: Замок и осадный шар: дыры, падения и бочки
scope: Castle horse plus the siege airship: holes and air leaks degrade flight, four holes burst it; a hard crash shatters the basket into splinters; the pilot has HP, takes measured fall damage and dies with a proper overlay; the balloon stays in the map. Weight steering, no cap, no anchor/Shift, crowd, gusts, ropes and powder barrels with the C4 blast remain.
